text:
No, our love's story was not so fleeting:
among the smooth pages
of the virgin book of your memory,
like a blue petal lies the glory,
sorrowful, noble, and chaste, of my verses.


You cannot forget me: I condemn you
to a tenacious memory. My love has been
the highest thing in your life, the best;
and only amid mud and mire
does the pale lotus of oblivion arise.


You will see me everywhere: in the uncertain
evening, in the blond dawn,
and when you work in the deserted
corridor, while in your garden tremble
the monotonous threads of rain.


And you will have to remember! That is the inheritance
my pain gives you, which nothing can soothe.
I will be a summit of light in your existence,
and an ineffable reproach in your conscience
and an immortal wake within your soul!

translation.title: Immortality
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the prophetic address and recurring memory, lotus, and immortal-trace imagery.
